title: Clawd X Digest
summary: 🤖 Next-Gen LLM Releases: xAI launches Grok 4.5 globally, while developers debate first-day impressions of Anthropic's new Opus 5 model, noting speed/cost improvements but mixed technical reliability compared to Fable 5.

🛠️ AI Infrastructure & Outages: OpenAI servers experience major outages with persistent Codex 503 errors, prompting users to discover currency devaluation arbitrage strategies for Codex 20x subscriptions via Google Play.

📈 Corporate and Security Shifts: Travel giant Ctrip (携程) reportedly faces a massive 5.1 billion RMB fine, while security developers advocate for scoped API key gateways to protect credentials for autonomous agents.
🌍 General Interest: In a blockbuster offseason move, 41-year-old NBA legend LeBron James is reportedly signing with the Philadelphia 76ers, sparking heavy fan reactions.

items.title: @grok: Grok 4.5 Release
items.body: xAI has launched Grok 4.5, its most capable model to date, now available across xai.com, X, and the official iOS/Android applications.

items.title: @theo: First Impressions of Opus 5
items.body: Early reviews position Anthropic's Opus 5 as a strange but useful in-between model, combining Fable 5's taste with GPT-5.6's reasoning depth, though users debate its target audience.

items.title: @kunchenguid: Hands-on Opus 5 Reliability
items.body: Opus 5 resolves cost and speed limitations of Fable 5, showing improved task-delegation judgment, but requires strict oversight due to minor factual errors that need prompt corrections.

items.title: @UnitreeRobotics: Omni-Modal Whole-Body Manipulation
items.body: Unitree introduces UnifoLM-OmniA-0.3, a single model enabling real-time omni-modal interaction and whole-body physical manipulation for home care and service robotics.

items.title: @arcee_ai: Open Model Partnership for Science
items.body: Arcee.ai partners with the U.S. Department of Energy to develop Genesis-Science-1, an open-weight AI model designed to execute reproducible scientific computing workflows.

items.title: @StephenNY: Ctrip Hit with Massive Fine
items.body: Ctrip (携程) reportedly faces a massive 5.1 billion RMB fine, sparking intense debate on regulatory impacts and investment viability for the travel giant.

items.title: @0xJoveXu: Codex Bolivian Devaluation Arbitrage
items.body: A viral post details a Codex 20x subscription arbitrage strategy where users capitalize on the Bolivian Peso devaluation via Google Play billing to secure subscriptions at a 40% discount.

items.title: @OomolStudio: Scoped Credentials for AI Agents
items.body: Oomol Studio showcases API key gateways as a secure alternative to exposing raw credentials, giving autonomous AI agents scoped access with safety guardrails.

items.title: @chheplo: OpenAI Subscription Usage Limit Reductions
items.body: OpenAI silently reduces weekly subscription allowances by one-third, masking the change behind free resets and the removal of the strict 5-hour limit.

items.title: @imwsl90: Speculating on Kimi K3 Open Source Economy
items.body: Local developers evaluate hardware costs (estimated at 12M RMB) to deploy Moonshot's upcoming Kimi K3 model locally for API token arbitrage.

items.title: @TouchlineX: LeBron James Signs with the 76ers
items.body: In a blockbuster NBA offseason move, 41-year-old basketball legend LeBron James is reportedly signing with the Philadelphia 76ers.

items.title: @DavorVitkovic: Jaylen Brown NBA Reaction
items.body: Basketball analysts and fans react to Jaylen Brown's potential team role dynamics in Philadelphia following recent trade rumors.

items.title: @it_Rutie: Viral Lionel Messi Photo
items.body: Fans react to a candid moment capturing Lionel Messi unaware of a selfie being taken by former teammates Neymar and Suárez.

items.title: @xiaohu: Notion Product Critiques
items.body: Notion faces criticism for cluttering its user interface with rapid, superficial AI additions rather than fundamentally re-architecting its editor under the hood.
